notes: Multi-turn token accumulation on Hermes: three identical no-op turns in ONE long-lived `hermes chat` REPL. Hermes writes NO transcript file - the daemon reads one shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db (ProcessOwnedStore), and the token vector comes off the `sessions` ROW (input_tokens/output_tokens/cache_read_tokens/cache_write_tokens, metrics.go:99-105/143-147), not from summed messages. That aggregate is monotone by construction: hermes' CLI path INCREMENTS it per API call (hermes_state.py:5008-5013 `input_tokens = input_tokens + ?`, called from conversation_loop.py:3001 with api_call_count=1), and session.MergeMetrics never lowers a token total. Live proof in the maintainer's store: a two-turn session (20260802_212408_63a639, message_count=4) carries input=16802 output=211 cache_read=15872 - turn 1 costs ~16269 fresh input, turn 2's fresh delta is 533 and 15872 tokens come from cache - so TotalTokens>0, non-decreasing, and CacheReadTokens>0 are all empirically observable. The scenario's fourth clause, 'fresh input tokens for THAT turn = 0', is NOT: irrlicht sees only the CUMULATIVE aggregate (the hermes Parser emits no UsageBreakdown/PerTurnContribution at all), so CumInputTokens stays >0 once turn 1 lands. That per-turn blindness is a caveat, not a downgrade - the load-bearing accumulator IS observed, unlike aider x 5.1 (cache line never reaches the watched markdown) and kiro-cli x 5.1 (no token trace anywhere), which are both incapable. NO metric hard-assertion is pinned in observations, and that is deliberate: of verify reads ONLY the replay golden summary (validate/observations.go:135-189), while hermes' tokens/cost are computed by ComputeMetrics over the store - a path replay never runs. tokens_nonzero would read cum_input+cum_output = 0 from a hermes golden and HARD-FAIL; total_tokens_nonzero is gated to antigravity (cmd/replay/metrics.go:59) and would read 0 too; events.jsonl is lifecycle-only (verified on the opencode 5.1 sibling recording). The token evidence is therefore checked on the LIVE metrics surface at record time via the recipe's verify[]; the unlock is to extend the #766 golden lift + StageReplayStore to hermes as #775/#776 did for antigravity. model/cost stay unpinned per #440 (the recorded model is whatever model.default the run's HERMES_HOME carries; live default gpt-5.6-luna IS priced). BIRTH: the sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message, so the sub-second ready birth is carried by the transient proc-<PID> pre-session the scanner mints; session_birth is anchored to start UNPINNED and every turn phase chains off t1_start via same_session_as so the presession cannot steal identity - the hermes 1-1/2-1/1-8 shape. All THREE arcs are pinned (unlike opencode 5.1, which de-pinned t3): hermes is one long-lived process with an explicit finish_reason='stop' boundary and 8s inter-turn sleeps against a 500ms-debounce/2s-poll watcher, so the arcs should be separable - if the recording shows t3 collapsing to zero width, de-pin it as opencode did.

text: A hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch (the transient proc-<PID> pre-session carries the sub-second birth; the store-backed <YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<hex> session lands once the first user message is persisted). Nothing ever enters waiting - three no-tool turns.
A PID is bound to the session (hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line)
Turn 1's prompt drives the store-backed session ready -> working (the user row is persisted before the LLM call and message_count grows)

Turn 1 completes back to ready on the same session (assistant row with finish_reason='stop'). AFTER this the live metrics surface must show total_tokens > 0 - asserted at the metrics tier, not in this phase DSL (events.jsonl carries no metric fields).
Turn 2's prompt drives the same session ready -> working

Turn 2 completes back to ready on the same session; total_tokens after T2 must be >= total_tokens after T1 (monotonic - hermes increments the sessions aggregate per API call), and this is the turn whose prefix the provider serves from cache (cache_read_tokens > 0). Metrics tier.
Turn 3's prompt drives the same session ready -> working

Turn 3 completes back to ready on the same session, closing the three-cycle topology with a final state of ready; total_tokens after T3 >= after T2 (monotonic accumulation across two boundaries). Metrics tier.
